question: In a certain coded language 'FERAL' is coded as 'GFVXG' and 'SMEAR' is coded as 'TNIXM'. How will 'PHOTO' be coded in the same code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46ff35ae43a27fd5623e2ba95fce6797e8d1de5a7a182f87d5b3273ad98babdf.png] The logic followed here is: Logic: Each letter of the word is shifted according to the fixed pattern: +1, +1, +4, -3, -5. Here, FERAL → GFVXG
